title: rails.gate/1 — consumed-token permission boundary
theorem: ValidSig does not entail Invoke. Invoke iff Candidate and G_syn and X. NotFresh_Sigma entails NotInvoke.
evidence_boundary: This contract authorizes tool invoke only. CITY-INSTRUMENT-RECEIPT status PASS is an observation of a check run, not a grant.

operators.V_obs: classifier or self_check label; annotate only
operators.G_syn: deterministic grant intersect args intersect window
operators.X: HMAC token bound to (tool, args_digest, grant_id, nonce, expiry); Fresh_Sigma is required and nonce is marked SPENT on ALLOW
